title: ELVAE: Evidential Learning-Based Variational Autoencoder for Uncertainty-Aware Generation
abstract:
arXiv:2608.10398v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: ELVAE places an input-dependent normal--inverse-gamma (NIG) hierarchy at each VAE latent coordinate, separating location uncertainty $u_{\mathrm{epi}}= eta/[
u(\alpha-1)]$ from conditional variability $u_{\mathrm{var}}= eta/(\alpha-1)$. The marginalized latent law, however, identifies only the three quotient coordinates $(\gamma,\alpha,c)$ with $c= eta(1+1/
u)$; reconstruction is blind to one $(
u, eta)$ fiber direction. A companion theoretical analysis shows that the complete NIG prior and forward KL select a unique prior-relative canonical representative on each fiber, so canonical inverse allocation is not a fourth independent information channel. u$ remains the strongest sensitivity-ranking score. At $	au_{\mathrm{epi}}=1$, the three-seed mean high/low-$u_{\mathrm{epi}}$ semantic-transition ratios are 1.98 on MNIST and 1.66 on Fashion-MNIST, falling to 1.33 and 1.16 under s

translated_title: ELVAE：基于证据学习的变分自编码器用于不确定性感知生成
translated_abstract:
arXiv:2608.10398v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：ELVAE在每个VAE潜在坐标上放置一个依赖于输入的normal-inverse-gamma（NIG）层次结构，将位置不确定性$u_{\mathrm{epi}}= eta/[
u(\alpha-1)]$与条件变异性$u_{\mathrm{var}}= eta/(\alpha-1)$分离。然而，边缘化的潜在法则仅识别三个商坐标$(\gamma,\alpha,c)$，其中$c= eta(1+1/
u)$；重建对$(
u, eta)$纤维方向的一个维度不可见。配套的理论分析表明，完整的NIG先验和前向KL在每个纤维上选择一个唯一的先验相对规范代表，因此规范逆分配不是第四个独立的信息通道。实验上，训练后的逆证据$1/
u$仍然是最强的敏感性排名分数。在$	au_{\mathrm{epi}}=1$时，三个种子的平均高/低$u_{\mathrm{epi}}$语义转换比率在MNIST上为1.98，在Fashion-MNIST上为1.66，在s下降至1.33和1.16。
tldr: ELVAE通过NIG层次结构有效分离位置不确定性与条件变异性，并证明逆证据是生成任务中最强的不确定性信号，显著提升语义转换性能。
en_tdlr: ELVAE effectively separates location uncertainty from conditional variability via an NIG hierarchy, demonstrating that inverse evidence is the strongest uncertainty signal for generation tasks, significantly improving semantic transition performance.
